stories.title: Hamilton Demands "Serious Talks" at Ferrari After Leclerc Mexico Clash

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Lewis Hamilton has had enough.

After Leclerc's aggressive Turn 4 move in Mexico — which earned a 5-second penalty — Hamilton is demanding "serious talks" within Ferrari before Brazil.

The tension at Maranello is boiling. #F1 #Ferrari

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Martin Brundle fears another Hamilton-Leclerc clash is coming at Brazil.

Ferrari's team boss says the Mexico incident will be addressed before São Paulo.

Will they race as teammates or rivals? #F1 #Ferrari

article.headline: Hamilton Demands "Serious Talks" at Ferrari After Leclerc Mexico Clash

stories.title: Antonelli Arrives in Brazil as Champion, to Wear Senna Tribute Helmet

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli arrives at Interlagos as the 2026 F1 World Champion 🏆

His first race as champion. A special Ayrton Senna tribute helmet. The 35th anniversary of Senna's legendary 1991 win at his home circuit.

This weekend is going to be special. #F1 #AntoBrazil

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
In 1991, Ayrton Senna won at Interlagos in front of his home crowd.

35 years later, Kimi Antonelli races as F1 champion at the same circuit — wearing a helmet in Senna's honor.

One of the most special weekends in F1 history. #F1 #Senna

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:

A title double — Drivers' AND Constructors' — could be confirmed Sunday. #F1 #Mercedes
